settings.heading: See it, pull the drawers, then decide.
settings.lead: Book a time at our Richmond, BC showroom, or a virtual walkthrough with the TOOSA team. Compare the sizes, test the slides and leave with a plan for your space.

settings.heading: A visit, not a sales pitch.
settings.lead: We built TOOSA for people who like to see things before they buy them. Here's how a visit goes.
settings.panel_text: Choose a date and time below. We confirm by email and you can reschedule any time.
settings.points: Every size side by side|Drawers, slides, locks and finishes|Foam, lighting and engraving samples|Financing and delivery answered on the spot

settings.title: Pick a time
settings.text: Choose a slot that suits you. Prefer a video call? Choose the virtual option and we'll walk the floor with the camera.

settings.title: Walk the floor
settings.text: Compare tool chests, hutches, side lockers and foam in person. Open every drawer; that's what they're there for.

settings.title: Plan your setup
settings.text: Bring your wall measurements and a photo of the space. We'll configure a layout that fits and grows with you.

settings.title: Order, finance, deliver
settings.text: Buy on the day or later online. Pay monthly with RBC if that helps, and choose delivery or pickup.

settings.heading: Easy, affordable monthly payments
settings.text:
We provide easy and affordable financing through our partner, PayPlan by RBC™, so you can pay for your purchase over time.

  • Affordable monthly plans. Buy now and pay over time at competitive interest rates.
  • No prepayment penalties. Pay monthly and prepay at any time without penalty.
  • Easy application. Get a decision in seconds with no obligation to buy. Checking your rate won't affect your credit score, and your data is safe and encrypted.

Questions? Check the PayPlan by RBC™ FAQs. Trademark of Royal Bank of Canada. Used under licence.
